title: Review: convergence check round 8
notes:
Maintainer risk: LOW — no P0/P1 issues found. All tests pass, clippy clean. pathLen enforcement verified correct by trace through RFC 5280 §4.2.1.9 semantics. P-521 returns a clear error (not wrong output). messageDigest comparison is variable-time but not over secret material — not a timing oracle.
Confidence: 5% chance of missed bug. Thorough read of all 14 files + test run + pathLen formal trace. Residual risk: KARI decrypt is trait-delegated so test coverage depends on implementor; AES-CBC padding oracle is caller-observable if attacker can repeatedly query decrypt() (but this is inherent to CBC mode, not a code bug).
Idiom rating: CLEAN — well-structured, good separation of concerns, appropriate error mapping, documented limitations. P-521 dead-code path in select_digest_for_cert is noted but documented.
